# Windows

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** Windows

## What it does

Opens the rusherhack window manager

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/Windows.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [ThunderHack Recode — Windows](https://github.com/Pan4ur/ThunderHack-Recode/blob/49c76bcc5a5e4fbd12b06305c09f0c8fb76c510b/src/main/java/thunder/hack/features/modules/client/Windows.java)

Opens a client window manager for macros, configurations, friends, waypoints, and proxies.

Basis: [source review](https://github.com/Pan4ur/ThunderHack-Recode/blob/49c76bcc5a5e4fbd12b06305c09f0c8fb76c510b/src/main/java/thunder/hack/features/modules/client/Windows.java).

### [RusherHack — Windows](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/Windows.html)

Opens the rusherhack window manager

Basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/Windows.html).
